Could you retrieve the details about this case for me? I don't need the full text of the case ruling. Second, I'm curious about the current classical chess rating of a player named Magnus Carlsen. Could you fetch that for me? Third, I'm trying to remember the date of the historical event known as the Battle of Gettysburg. Do you know when that took place? Lastly, I'm working on a physics problem and need to calculate the final speed of an object. The object was dropped from a height of 100 meters with an initial velocity of 0 m/s. The gravitational acceleration is 9.8 m/s^2. Can you help me calculate the final speed?"
